articles.title: How do solar storms impact Earth’s magnetic field? ISRO’s Aditya-L1 decodes
articles.summary: ISRO's Aditya-L1 solar mission has provided crucial new insights into how powerful solar storms affect Earth's magnetic shield. The data helps understand the most severe impacts during direct storm events, contributing significantly to space weather research. This understanding is vital for improving predictions and developing mitigation strategies against solar disturbances, enhancing planetary protection.

articles.title: Republic Day 2026: Why Delhi govt is using 1,275 kg of boneless chicken to guard the sky
articles.summary: For the Republic Day celebrations, the Delhi Forest Department adopted an unusual strategy to ensure the safety of fighter jet flypasts. They deployed 1,275 kg of boneless chicken to deter birds from the flight path over the national capital's skies. This unique approach aims to minimize bird strikes, safeguarding both the aircraft and spectators during the aerial display.

articles.title: Statement by Russian Defence Ministry
articles.summary: Overnight, five Ukrainian fixed-wing unmanned aerial vehicles were successfully intercepted and neutralised by alerted air defence systems.
